challenge: Two destinations, one brand — each needed its own character without splitting the story.
solution: A shared design language with a portal per island, leading with philosophy and imagery before the booking step.
name: Rocks Villas
tagline: Privacy, comfort and authentic island living.
description: A refined collection of handpicked villas across Mykonos and Paros. One brand, two destination portals — a calm, image-led site that leads with philosophy and story before it ever asks you to book.

challenge: Personalising a physical product online usually means a clunky upload form and doubt about the final print.
solution: An in-browser editor for upload, crop and adjust, wrapped in a three-step order flow so the gift stays simple to order.
name: Magnetica
description: Custom photo magnets, printed in Greece. The store is built around an in-browser editor — upload, crop and adjust your photo — wrapped in a three-step order flow that keeps a personal gift feeling simple.

challenge: An artist’s body of work — films, performances, writing — had to read like a screening, not a CV.
solution: Pacing and motion borrowed from cinema: full-bleed media, deliberate transitions and calm, typographic navigation.
name: Michael Mantas
tagline: The camera as witness. Between memory and projection.
description: A home for a Greek-Canadian filmmaker and performance artist working in autoethnographic cinema. Films, performances, writing and talks — paced like a screening rather than a CV.

challenge: A graphic design studio needed a site that behaves like its work: raw, tactile and print-minded.
solution: A monochrome retro-system interface built around oversized type, texture and interaction details.
name: Nove Graphics
description: An Athens graphic design studio working in posters, album art and identity. A monochrome, retro-system interface — NOVE_GRAPHICS.EXE — built around oversized type, cinematic texture and print.

challenge: A clinical practice has to feel warm and trustworthy, and make booking a consultation obvious.
solution: Clear paths for individuals and businesses, recipes and articles, and a straightforward booking flow.
name: Melina Tsagkataki
description: A clinical dietitian’s practice, online. Clear paths for individuals and businesses, recipes and articles, and booking for consultations by phone or video — warm, approachable and easy to act on.

challenge: A deep bilingual catalogue of signage and road safety equipment that contractors need to search quickly.
solution: A structured product architecture with category-first navigation, so the right part is a few clicks away.
name: ΣΗΜΑ
description: A Greek manufacturer of traffic signs and road safety equipment. A deep, bilingual product catalogue — signage, site equipment, pavement materials — organised so contractors find the right part fast.
